name: Dick Durbin

lean.basis: Democratic congressman (1983–1997) and U.S. senator from Illinois since 1997; Senate Democratic whip since 2005.

office.title: Senate Democratic whip; ranking member, Senate Judiciary Committee (retiring January 2027)

source.title: File:Dick Durbin 2022 official portrait (cropped).jpg — Wikimedia Commons

current_role: U.S. senator from Illinois and Senate Democratic whip (since 2005); not seeking re-election, leaves office January 2027
summary: Dick Durbin has been a U.S. senator from Illinois since 1997 and the Senate Democrats' whip, their second-ranking leader, since 2005, serving under Harry Reid and then Chuck Schumer; he chaired the Judiciary Committee from 2021 to 2025. He announced on April 23, 2025 that he would not seek re-election in 2026.

connections.name: Chuck Schumer
connections.description: Durbin has been Schumer's whip, the No. 2 Senate Democrat, since Schumer became leader in 2017; in 2015 they agreed on Schumer as Reid's successor with Durbin keeping the whip post.

sources.title: Schumer announces Senate Democratic leadership team for the 119th Congress — Senate Democrats
Senate Democrats stick with Schumer as leader — PBS NewsHour (AP)

connections.name: Barack Obama
connections.description: Illinois's two senators from 2005 to 2008; Durbin introduced his fellow Illinoisan at the 2008 Democratic National Convention.

sources.title: Durbin's Long Shot Pays Off — Roll Call
Web Extra: Durbin on President Obama — WTTW

connections.name: Donald Trump
connections.description: Durbin voted to convict Trump in his first impeachment trial and, after January 6, 2021, blamed him for the attack and called for invoking the 25th Amendment.

connections.name: Josh Hawley
connections.description: Durbin said Hawley, who objected to certifying the 2020 election, was partly responsible for the January 6, 2021 attack.
